gpt-5-mini.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development (PYD) was calculated from the gross claims development table (triangle) because the 'Movement in prior year's provision' note and the Managing Agent narrative present NET prior year releases. The triangle-based gross PYD is estimated at a release of ~GBP 57.087m. The segmental prior-year movements shown in the notes are explicitly described as net (after reinsurance) and therefore were not used for the required GROSS PYD figure. Lob_movements above use the net breakdown from the prior-year movement note (lower confidence) because the report does not provide gross PYD by LOB. Where regulatory categories combine classes (e.g. 'Marine, aviation and transport'), mapping to standard Lloyd's LOBs is approximate and confidence lowered accordingly.
